correctness.rationale: The 4x4 anti-exchange unitary only mixes |00> and |11>, so for a diagonal incoming system population p the reduced system map is p->q p+(1-q)(1+m)/2 and p_{k-1}=[1+m(1-q^{k-1})]/2. Under ancilla partial transpose the unique possible negative eigenvalue is in the 01/10 block, giving N_k=[m sqrt((2-h)^2+4q(1-q)h^2)-1-m^2(1-h)]_+/4 for h=q^{k-1}. Its strict positivity condition factors with one positive root h_*=(1-m^2)/[m(sqrt(1+4q(1-q))-m)], for 0<m<1; h decreases, hence the first L=ceil(log(h_*)/log q) collisions are entangling iff m>1/sqrt(1+4q(1-q)), with no late birth or revival. For m=1 every finite k has positive but vanishing negativity; for m=0 or q endpoints none. Maximization q(1-q)<=1/4 yields m>1/sqrt2 over angles, and h_*~(1-m^2)/(v-1) yields logarithmic growth. Independently constructed joint density matrices and ancilla partial transposes for five regimes up to k=17, agreeing with the formula to 1e-12; near machine precision late pure-bath positivity is analytic rather than inferred from numerical thresholding.
